segments.text: You think you're the one making your decisions. Meet the other guy in your head who actually makes most of them.
System one is fast, automatic, emotional. It runs the show, and it's usually right enough to be dangerous.
System two is slow, deliberate, does the math, and it's lazy. It mostly rubber-stamps whatever system one already decided.
Knowing they exist won't stop your snap judgments. But it tells you exactly when to slow down and switch which one is driving.
The best idea in the book. Honest verdict on the channel.
